findings.note: `.detail__flavor` uses `white-space: pre-line`, but `formatFlavorText` collapses all newlines/form-feeds to single spaces, so pre-line never has multi-line content to act on. Harmless but effectively dead styling intent.

`formatMultiplier` exists both as a module-level function and as a thin protected method wrapper for template binding. Acceptable (templates can't call module functions directly), but slightly redundant.

Missing attacker types are fetched in a second concurrency pass after the primary type fetch; sequential round-trips add latency for dual-type Pokémon. Correct, just not maximally parallel. Likely intentional given the union must be known first (documented in comment).

verdict: 全 Acceptance Criteria を満たす完成度の高い実装。図鑑情報(整形・ja/en・en フォールバック)、タイプ相性(単/複合×4/×0.25・無効・等倍除外・past_damage_relations 非対象・名前ローカライズ/識別子フォールバック)、鳴き声(latest→legacy→null・直接 Audio・穏当なフォールバック・アクセシブルラベル)がいずれも正しく、言語切替にも追従する。BFF/web の Vitest と Playwright e2e がエッジケースまで網羅し、Angular 21 のシグナル/standalone/新制御フロー/strict TS の慣習に沿う。指摘は軽微な冗長性のみで実害なし。
